badgeBoxes.description:
Shared line-layout output (M3 §4.6.3/§5.6). Present on measured
views only; the compatibility path carries no `measurements` key.

channels.description:
Box of every placed edge label, keyed by relation occurrence id, in
world units. Present on measured views only. A label the capped
gutters cannot hold has no box and one `label-unplaced` warning. A
host draws labels from these boxes and unions them into its fit
bounds (DEC-5, BF-7).

edgeBundles.description: Lifted parallel relations share a route; semantic occurrences remain intact.

orientations.description:
Orientation chosen per packed level (§4.1, §6.1). Present on measured
views only; the host feeds it back as `previousOrientation`.

diagnostics.description: `validateDocument`'s diagnostics, verbatim, when the refusal is `document-invalid`.

limitations: Defaults are not represented in declaration types and are not extracted (K1b-Q5 profile).

hops.description: Semantic relation refs in walk order from semanticTarget to the drawn entity.

members.description: Aggregate only: complete carrier set in fixed source/target/relation order.

details.description: Scalar facts a caller may act on (expected/seen revisions, bounds, kinds).

path.description: Where, as a dotted path into the document or view (`entities.entity:n1.attributes.size`).

refs.description: The references the diagnostic is about, raw, so a caller can highlight them.

fitZoom.description: The zoom a fit or reset applies.

profile.description: The profile that declares this entity's type. Must be one of the document's `profileRefs`.

type.description: A profile entity type id, or a document type definition id.

group.description: A visual group id, when this drawing sits in one. Visual grouping is NOT containment.

z.description: Explicit paint order. A field, never an array position.

profilePin.description: Rows are unique by `ProfileId`; a pin verifies bytes, never chooses between duplicates.

axis.description: Axis of the gap (horizontal gap separates columns).

pans.description: True when the drawing is still wider than the target at {@link MIN_ZOOM}: the host pans inside the canvas.

phone.description: True when the target width is at most {@link PHONE_MAX_WIDTH}.

width.description: Finalized width `B` at scale 1, world units: the union width, not the placement width.

zoom.description: `presentation.camera.zoom` of the produced view: 1, or down to {@link MIN_ZOOM}.

direction.description:
How the group packs its items on a measured view (DC-2a §3.7): `rows` =
horizontal shelves filled left to right and wrapping downward, `columns` =
vertical shelves filled top to bottom and wrapping rightward. Before
DC-2a `rows` was one vertical stack and `columns` one horizontal row.

gapAfter.description: Gap after this group inside its level, replacing the base gap; refused above the axis cap.

rootOrder.description:
Declaration order of the root level (DC-2a §6.4) of a measured view:
listed roots first, unlisted visible roots after in UTF-16 order (the
documented degraded mode — a host supplies the full order).

details.description: Structured overflow detail (needed/allocated sizes, side, required/fitted slots).

anchor.description: Position along the side, 0..1 from the side's start.

diagram.description: Typed presentation fragment (M3 §3.2.2). Absent means no presentation contract.

theme.description: A theme id the host resolves. No colour, no token value is stored here.

contentHash.description: Hash of the source content, always present - it is what makes drift detectable.

namespace.description: Namespace URI. Identity of an extension is (namespace, schemaVersion, scope).

source.description:
The source content, when the importer retained it. Its absence is the one
documented reason a command over extensions is NOT invertible: a replaced
extension whose source was never retained cannot be restored from a hash.

integer.description: When true, only integers validate; a fraction is refused.

targetTypes.description: K2 target types: the referenced entity's resolved chain must contain one.

endpoints.description:
Two or more typed endpoints. A hyperrelation (`generic@1`'s `association`,
2..8 members) keeps ONE business id: a projection may turn it into a
junction node, and the id survives that projection (study invariant 4).

role.description: A role declared by the relation type. Not a position: `endpoints[0]` means nothing.

target.description:
An entity, a semantic port or a semantic relation (M3 §3.9.1). The kinds
are not interchangeable (the role declares which). A RelationRef target
is permitted only where the semantic role admits relation targets.

strokeStyle.description:
The only stroke carrier (M3 §3.2.2/§3.5), default solid. Absent is distinct
from explicit solid and is preserved byte-for-byte.

waypoints.description: Persisted route hints. An empty/absent list means "the renderer routes it".

chainProvenance.description: Document-proven chain: requires semanticTarget and excludes sourceOccurrence.

occurrence.description:
The occurrence this end attaches to: an entity, port or relation
occurrence (M3 §3.9.1/§4.4.2). A relation occurrence draws a RelationRef
target through its `relation` field.

role.description: The role of the relation this end draws. Matched against the relation's own endpoints.

semanticTarget.description:
The semantic endpoint target for this role, copied verbatim. Present iff
the drawn `occurrence` does not itself draw that target (fold or chain
provenance). A RelationRef is permitted only where the semantic
role admits relation targets.

sourceOccurrence.description:
The original endpoint occurrence in the retained source view. Present iff
fold provenance is used; mutually exclusive with `chainProvenance`.

uri.description: An identifier for the host's resolver. NOTHING here fetches, parses or executes it.

targetAspect.description: Target outer aspect of every packed level, chrome included (token `diagramZone.rowPackTargetAspect`).

revision.description: Monotonic. A command bumps it; undo is a NEW revision, never a rewrite.

relationIds.description: Sorted, distinct, non-empty semantic relation ids of the selected set.

relationOccurrences.description:
Complete selected candidate occurrence set for the scope/style. Absent
means the scope/style must select at most one occurrence per relation
id; present must list every selected occurrence (sorted, distinct).

strokeStyle.description: Absent selects solid only. Solid and dashed never aggregate together.

minLength.description: Minimum length. A present value below it is refused (pattern "min-length").

pattern.description: Anchored ASCII RegExp source, no flags. `patternName` is required with it.

minLength.description: Minimum length. A present value below it is refused (pattern "min-length").

pattern.description: Anchored ASCII RegExp source, no flags. `patternName` is required with it.

integer.description: When true, only integers validate; a fraction is refused.

targetTypes.description: K2 target types: the referenced entity's resolved chain must contain one.

value.description: Compared against the attribute value's own `value` field, as text.

revision.description: The document revision this view was last changed at. Never ahead of the document.

summaryLabels.description:
Authored aggregate-label definitions (M3 §4.5.1), keyed by definition id.
Absent means no authored labels; derived count labels are computed at
render time and never stored. Definitions survive projection byte for
byte; activation is derived, never persisted.

occurrence.description:
The entity occurrence this group folds (M3 §4.1.1). Present on every fold
group in a completed-profile view. Membership is still derived through
`EntityOccurrence.group`, never stored here.

collapsed.description: Controlled fold state: collapsed occurrence ids.

defaultFolds.description: Initial collapsed occurrence ids when `collapsed` is not controlled.

hints.description: Declaration order (`rootOrder`, `ordering[parent]`) and the other layout hints.

label.description: Accessible name of the figure. Defaults to `title`.

measureLines.description: Layout line measurer. Defaults to the bridge over `measure`.

metrics.description: Runtime token numbers for the engine (gaps, caps).

targetWidth.description: L-R7 report width. The measured path never re-packs on it (D-3).

view.description: Retained source view (occurrences, fold groups). Optional: the engine synthesises one.

value.description: Compared against the attribute value's own `value` field, as text.

summaryLabels.description:
Authored aggregate-label definitions (M3 §4.5.1), keyed by definition id.
Absent means no authored labels; derived count labels are computed at
render time and never stored. Definitions survive projection byte for
byte; activation is derived, never persisted.

occurrence.description:
The entity occurrence this group folds (M3 §4.1.1). Present on every fold
group in a completed-profile view. Membership is still derived through
`EntityOccurrence.group`, never stored here.

collapsed.description: Controlled fold state: collapsed occurrence ids.

defaultFolds.description: Initial collapsed occurrence ids when `collapsed` is not controlled.

hints.description: Declaration order (`rootOrder`, `ordering[parent]`) and the other layout hints.

label.description: Accessible name of the figure. Defaults to `title`.

measureLines.description: Layout line measurer. Defaults to the bridge over `measure`.

metrics.description: Runtime token numbers for the engine (gaps, caps).

targetWidth.description: L-R7 report width. The measured path never re-packs on it (D-3).

view.description: Retained source view (occurrences, fold groups). Optional: the engine synthesises one.
